package prompt

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

func TestNotifyExitRestoresPasswordState(t *testing.T) {
	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = pr.Close() })
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = pw.Close() })

	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
	term := &fakeTerm{reader: pr}
	cr.term = term
	cr.fd = 0 // arbitrary descriptor; fakeTerm does not use it.

	stdinMU.Lock()
	oldStdin := stdin
	stdinMU.Unlock()
	SetStdin(cr)
	t.Cleanup(func() { SetStdin(oldStdin) })

	readDone := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err := cr.ReadPassword(context.Background())
		readDone <- err
	}()
	require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
		cr.mu.Lock()
		defer cr.mu.Unlock()
		return cr.state == readerStatePassword && cr.previousTermState != nil
	}, time.Second, time.Millisecond, "password read did not start")

	NotifyExit()
	require.True(t, term.restoreCalled, "NotifyExit did not restore the terminal")
	select {
	case err := <-readDone:
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrReaderClosed)
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("password read did not stop after NotifyExit")
	}
}

func TestInput(t *testing.T) {

	write := func(t *testing.T, s string) {

	ctx := context.Background()

		go write(t, "hi")
		got, err := Input(ctx, io.Discard, r, "")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, got, "hi")
	})

	t.Run("with whitespace", func(t *testing.T) {
		go write(t, "hey\n")
		got, err := Input(ctx, io.Discard, r, "")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, got, "hey")
	})

	t.Run("closed input", func(t *testing.T) {
		require.NoError(t, in.Close())
		got, err := Input(ctx, io.Discard, r, "")
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
		require.Empty(t, got)
	})
}

item.text:
Fixed terminal restoration for `tsh login`. A canceled password read now restores the terminal and moves the reader to clean mode; `Close` restores it before marking the reader closed. Added `NotifyExit` and called it from `tsh` after `Run` returns.

Two delegated agents handled the exit path and focused tests; I integrated and verified their changes. The prompt package tests, race tests, and `git diff --check` pass. A compile-only `tsh` check was stopped after more than two minutes under this container’s process limits.
